bio: Partners Oscar de Matos and Nadine Baumgartner are back in Lucerne, in a perfect location in the old town, right on the River Reuss. Diners can look forward to a pleasingly relaxed, tasteful and modern bistro atmosphere. Using top-quality ingredients, the open kitchen produces bold, creative dishes that are out of the ordinary and characterised by an intense interplay of acidity and contrasts, for example, yellowtail, plum, elderflower and bonito escabeche, pico de gallo, fig leaf. In their own words: unusual, but down-to-earth and with a pinch of punk is how they aptly describe themselves. There is a four- or six-course set menu – the opening gambit in the form of a selection of tapas reflecting the chef's roots gets things off to a fantastic start. Hostess Nadine Baumgartner impresses – ...
